name: OmniRoute
description: Connects a project to an OmniRoute AI gateway: the project's agents list the gateway's models and ask one of them through MCP tools, and members check the gateway, its models and the key's usage on a page and from the CLI.

base_url.title: Gateway URL
base_url.description: The root of the OmniRoute instance, such as https://omniroute.example.com, without /v1. Only https, on a host whose every address is public.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: An OmniRoute API key made for this hub in the gateway's dashboard (API Manager). Turn on its usage command to show usage.

default_model.title: Default model
default_model.description: The model a question goes to when it names none: a model id of the gateway, or a combo such as auto.

max_tokens.title: Answer length
max_tokens.description: The most tokens one answer may take, unless the question asks for fewer.

ask_role.title: Who may ask
ask_role.description: The lowest project role whose members may ask a model from the page and the CLI; agents ask through the MCP tool.

routes.name: status
routes.title: Gateway status
routes.description: GET answers whether the project's gateway is set, reachable and accepts the key, with its latency, the number of models and the key's usage.

routes.name: models
routes.title: Models
routes.description: GET lists the gateway's models; query q (a word of the id), capability (vision, tool_calling, reasoning) and limit (1 to 500).

routes.name: ask
routes.title: Ask a model
routes.description: POST {"prompt": "...", "model", "system", "max_tokens"} sends one question to the gateway and answers the model's reply with its usage.

mcp_tools.name: models
mcp_tools.title: List the gateway's models
mcp_tools.description: Lists the models and combos the project's OmniRoute gateway serves, optionally only those whose id holds a word or that have a capability. Use it to pick a model for omniroute__ask.

query.description: A word the model id must contain, such as gemini or sonnet.

mcp_tools.name: ask
mcp_tools.title: Ask a model through the gateway
mcp_tools.description: Sends one question to a model of the project's OmniRoute gateway and answers its reply, with the model that answered and the tokens it used. Good for a second opinion, a translation or a cheap summary; the answer must come within 25 seconds.

prompt.description: The question or the text to work on.

model.description: A model id from omniroute__models; the project's default model when left out.

system.description: Instructions the model reads before the prompt.

max_tokens.description: The most tokens the answer may take.

mcp_tools.name: usage
mcp_tools.title: The gateway key's usage
mcp_tools.description: Says what the project's OmniRoute key spent today and this week against its limits, and the quota each provider connection reports, when the key's usage command is on.

cli.name: status
cli.help: whether the project's OmniRoute gateway is set, reachable and accepts its key

cli.name: models
cli.help: the models of the project's OmniRoute gateway

args.name: q
args.help: a word the model id must contain

cli.name: ask
cli.help: send one question to a model of the project's OmniRoute gateway

args.name: model
args.help: a model id; the project's default model when left out

args.name: max_tokens
args.help: the most tokens the answer may take

pages.name: gateway
pages.title: OmniRoute
pages.description: The project's OmniRoute gateway: its state, the key's usage, its models and a box to ask one of them.
